name: slow-loading-state
title: Slow loading state
description: A loader that gets more honest the longer it waits: quiet at first, then a reassuring line, then Cancel and Try again.
docs: Wrap the content that will appear when loading ends. Nothing shows for the first 300 ms (delay), then a spinner and the label; thresholds are two plain numbers in ms, 8000 and 20000 by default, for the reassuring line and for Cancel and Try again. Each stage is announced politely. Everything resets when loading flips or Try again is pressed. When Cancel or Try again goes away, keyboard focus rests on the component; move it on in onCancel to the content or the trigger.
